title: Continuity and ties.
officialText: The structural integrity requirements of ACI 318, Section 16.5, shall apply. In precast and composite structures, ties within precast structural elements shall be continuous and shall be anchored to the supporting structure. In addition to Sections 1916.2.2 and 1916.2.4, the following requirements shall be met.
